title: Arc de Triumph and the Seine River cruise
text:
We enjoyed the Arc de Triumph!
Got one of our most beautiful photos of the Eiffel Tower from the top of the Arc De Triumph!!💖✨
We loved the night Seine River Cruise and got more beautiful Eiffel Tower photos!
Beautiful weather during our tours!!!!💖✨
author: Gloria_B

title: Locating the tickets was...
text: Locating the tickets was a little complicated but otherwise everything was great. I loved that I could do what I wanted at my own pace.
author: Nofar_A

title: Amazing View from the Top!
text: We booked a combo ticket with the Louvre Museum, Seine River Cruise and the Arc De Triomphe. The tunnel to go under the circle was tricky to find, but had a nice treat once inside with a man playing an accordion. It is a long climb (284+ steps) and not for the weary, so bring water and good walking shoes. Once you get there it is a Beautiful view of the city from the top.
author: Gina_Y

title: Two "Must Dos" in Paris.
text: I was with our family of 8 and we thoroughly enjoyed the view from the top of the Arch ... beautiful.  It was very cold that day but that didn't stop us.  In case of mobility issues there is an elevator.  The night cruise on the Seine was just as beautiful.  I had not ideas there were so many bridges across the Seine.  I highly recommend.
author: Pamela_J

title: One of the best views of Paris!
text: I loved the whole experience, I went as soon as it opened on the Saturday and didn't have to queue... went straight in and enjoyed the visit very much! The views are fantastic and you can take great photos! Just bear in mind that you have lots of steps to go up (and down!)
author: Belen_S

title: Paris 2025
text: Very good. Plenty of windy steps to the top but worth it for the view. Get there early for the cruise if you want to sit outside
author: David G

title: Great value for the...
text: Great value for the money! Arc de Triomphe gave great views of the city. River Seine tour was informative
author: Robert_L

title: I learn so much about...
text: I learn so much about Paris, France history. a great self guided tour and great gift shop. The river cruise portion was fun. Don’t forget to download the app
author: Delphine_V

title: Seeing the city from the Arc de Triomphe
text: Going up the Arc de Triomphe and seeing the city from above and the cruise in the Seine River was beautiful 🤩
author: Maribel_B

title: Great Experience
text: Great experience. Highly recommend. The stairs were a challenge for some but worth it as the view is awesome.
author: sean
